svg.title: Make a little snow man — step 4: Give your snow person a face
svg.desc: Gently press suitable smooth stones into the head for eyes. Make a smile with a curved twig or marks in the snow and add two twig arms. Try a pine cone for a hat or a carrot for a nose. For an upside-down version, a grown-up can help put the face on the bottom ball and small boots on top of a low, stable stack.
